elements.contents:
2025-11-27HelixGuard Team3 min read

GeoServer WMS GetMap XML External Entity Injection Vulnerability(CVE-2025-58360)

GeoServer is an open-source geospatial server used to publish and share spatial data and map services through standardized OGC interfaces. In affected versions, the WMS GetMap endpoint fails to disable external entity expansion when parsing SLD/XML documents.

elements.contents:

Shai-Hulud Returns: Over 1K NPM Packages and 27K+ Github Repos infected via Fake Bun Runtime Within Hours

Over 1,000 NPM packages were infected using the same method as the previous attack, infecting with a fake Bun runtime. The attacker leveraged the `preinstall` script to download and execute a malicious payload, stealing sensitive information from the compromised machines.

Milvus Proxy Authentication Bypass Vulnerability(CVE-2025-64513)

Milvus is an open-source vector database designed for generative AI workloads. In affected versions, the Proxy treats the user-controlled HTTP header `sourceId` as an internal component credential.

Attacker Target VSCode Extension Marketplace, IDE Plugins Face Higher Supply Chain Attack Risks

VSCode extension marketplace and IDE plugins are vulnerable to supply chain attacks, as attackers can publish malicious extensions that contain hidden backdoors or exploit existing vulnerabilities. This could lead to unauthorized access, data exposure, or even complete system compromise.
